events.what_it_is: A free immersive bodega-themed pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, with photo moments, treats and branded merchandise/prize opportunities.
events.what_is_free: Free admission, TEMPTATIONS treats and opportunities to win exclusive merchandise.
events.caveats: Free treats and merchandise/prizes are promotional and may be limited by supply. No advance RSVP requirement is published by the brand.
events.practical_notes: Physical NYC pop-up runs Sept. 17–19, noon–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary x SUKOSHI Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A three-day Japanese-wellness-themed Apothékary takeover with tongue readings, tincture education and sampling, and kakigori shaved ice while supplies last.
events.what_is_free: Free event registration, tincture sampling, wellness experiences and kakigori while supplies last; first 50 guests each day receive a mini tincture.
events.caveats: First-50 mini tincture, kakigori and gifts are while supplies last. Products are also sold; no purchase is required for the advertised free event registration.
events.practical_notes: Friday hours differ from Saturday/Sunday. Use the Eventbrite listing organized by Apothékary for free registration.

events.what_it_is: DedCool's first cafe and retail pop-up, celebrating the Mocha Magic fragrance with cafe drinks, fragrance sampling, exclusive merchandise and gifts.
events.what_is_free: Fragrance sampling; first 50 people in line each day receive a special gift. Other drinks/products may be sold.
events.caveats: Partiful provides an RSVP/guest-list mechanism, but independent current reporting describes the retail pop-up as open to the public; Stumblday specifically reports walk-ins. Treat RSVP as optional rather than guaranteed admission. First-50 gifts are supply-limited.
events.practical_notes: Open Sept. 18–20, 9 AM–6 PM daily. Cafe items and retail products are for sale.

events.event_name: Pura Vida x Brown Bee Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A two-day Brown Bee activation at Pura Vida Nolita pairing PB smoothies with full-size Brown Bee product and an exclusive gift for early guests.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 guests can receive the advertised PB smoothie, full-size product and exclusive Brown Bee gift, subject to supply.
events.caveats: The giveaway is limited to the first 100 and is supply-limited. No advance RSVP requirement is published in the two current listings checked.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–19, 10 AM–6 PM daily at Pura Vida Nolita.

events.address: Chelsea Triangle, West 14th Street and 9th Avenue, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A public KILIAN PARIS activation for the new Cocktails Collection with complimentary mocktails, fragrance samples and gifts with purchase.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary mocktails and fragrance samples while supplies last. Gifts require purchase.
events.caveats: Complimentary items are while supplies last; exclusive gifts are gifts with purchase. Current secondary listings disagree on a street-number rendering, so the venue is preserved as Chelsea Triangle at West 14th Street and 9th Avenue rather than asserting the conflicting number.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18 only, noon–8 PM. Open to the public.

events.address: Pier 17, 89 South Street, New York, NY 10038
events.what_it_is: A Dunkin' sampling truck at Pier 17 serving drink samples and promotional swag.
events.what_is_free: Free samples of Iced Pumpkin Latte, Berry Clementine Refresher and Strawberry Dragon Fruit Refresher, plus swag, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Samples and swag are while supplies last. No advance RSVP requirement is published in the current listings checked.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18, 2:30–6 PM at Pier 17 / the Seaport.

events.what_it_is: A three-day SACHEU beauty pop-up with product experiences, consultations, games/prizes, an immersive installation and a chance to meet Sarah Cheung.
events.what_is_free: Free full-size product for attendees while supplies last, plus games/prizes and product experiences. A separate gift-with-purchase requires a qualifying recent Ulta Beauty purchase.
events.caveats: The organizer fine print says RSVP does not guarantee entry, attendance or a reserved line position. Entry is explicitly first come, first served and subject to venue capacity. Promotional products are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Runs Sept. 18–20 at 541 W 25th St. The current NYC for FREE listing verifies Sept. 18 hours as 11 AM–5 PM; later-date hours were not positively verified in this pass and are not invented.
